dedupe_keys.name: tm forum information framework sid gb922 telecom information and data model

description: The Information Framework, known as SID (Shared Information and Data model) and published as the GB922 document suite, is the industry-standard information model for telecommunications operators, maintained by TM Forum. It defines the business entities an operator manages and how they relate, grouped into domains such as Market, Sales, Customer, Product, Service, Resource, Business Partner and Enterprise, with shared patterns; the Resource and Service domains describe network equipment, logical and physical resources, locations and the services built on them, and so serve as a common schema for network inventory. SID grew from member contributions and earlier models such as ITU-T M.3100 and the DMTF Common Information Model, aligns with TM Forum's business process (eTOM) and functional frameworks, and now sits within the Open Digital Architecture, with a model in Sparx Enterprise Architect format and conformance certification. Releases are numbered by year, with version 25 current in 2025 and 2026. Coverage: generic, used by operators worldwide. Format and access: guidebooks and model files from the TM Forum resource library, where downloads need a login and most require TM Forum membership; no open licence. Caveats: large and abstract, and operators implement it partially; not a dataset of real assets. Simulation uses: a common schema for building telecom network digital twins and for exchanging inventory data between planning, operations and resilience tools. Related records: the reference topologies from Telefónica and the SEASON project show network data in practice.
